documents.title: Trust anchor overlap
documents.text: During certificate authority rotation, distribute both trust anchors before renewing the intermediate issuer. Keep the previous chain trusted until every workload has renewed. Zoë recorded the overlap window.

documents.title: PKIX chain transition
documents.text: A PKIX chain rollover must preserve an overlap between old and new roots. Removing the former root early makes clients reject certificates that are still valid. The rollover is a plan, not a completed operation.

documents.title: WAL replay on standby
documents.text: PostgreSQL streams WAL records to a standby. Measure replay lag before promoting that replica; a successful connection alone does not prove it has replayed the last committed transaction.

documents.title: Recovering an asynchronous copy
documents.text: After the leader crashes, an asynchronous follower can be behind its durable log. Reapply the archived transaction segments and verify the recovery position before accepting writes. No failover has been performed.

documents.title: OIDC signing key overlap
documents.text: OIDC tokens carry a signing-key identifier. Publish the replacement key in JWKS before issuing tokens with it, and retain the old public key until existing tokens expire. The issuer and audience must still match.

documents.title: Validating an identity token
documents.text: An OpenID Connect relying party checks the token signature against the discovered key set. It also validates the intended recipient and provider identifier. A matching email address alone is insufficient authentication.

documents.title: Trust during key discovery
documents.text: Fetch the JWKS document over HTTPS and validate its certificate chain. OIDC signing-key rotation and transport trust are separate checks; accepting an unsigned token is never a workaround for an expired certificate.

documents.title: Budgeted workload eviction
documents.text: Kubernetes eviction respects a PodDisruptionBudget during voluntary node maintenance. Check available replicas and readiness before draining the node. A budget does not prevent an involuntary hardware failure.

documents.title: Keeping replicas available
documents.text: A rolling deployment should keep enough ready instances while replacing old pods. Kubernetes admission may refuse a voluntary removal that would violate the disruption allowance. This note does not claim the rollout succeeded.

documents.title: Lunch arrangements
documents.text: Bring pears and sandwiches to the picnic on Saturday. The blue blanket is beside the basket. There are no infrastructure instructions in this note.

documents.title: Independent trust anchor overlap
documents.text: During certificate authority rotation, distribute both trust anchors before renewing the intermediate issuer. Keep the previous chain trusted until every workload has renewed. Zoë recorded the overlap window.

documents.title: Cache refusal is not database retirement
documents.text: The checkout-api does not use Redis for persistence. Its PostgreSQL database remains active. Reject the proposed cache endpoint change; this sentence does not withdraw the database configuration.
